question: How to Choose Pull Up and Pull Down Resistor Values?
body_html:
Pull up and pull down resistor values balance speed, power and noise immunity. A pull up ties the line to Vcc so it idles high; a pull down ties it to ground so it idles low.

ApplicationTypical value
General purpose input10 kΩ
I2C at 100 kHz4.7 kΩ to 10 kΩ
I2C at 400 kHz1.5 kΩ to 2.2 kΩ
Battery powered switch100 kΩ to 470 kΩ

Low state current is I = Vcc ÷ R, so 5 V across 5 kΩ gives 1 mA.
